label: Interactive
title: A garden you walk through instead of a page you scroll.
subtitle: The whole portfolio as one WebGL scene - project beds, an old oak, a potting shed and a mailbox by the gate.
hint: Walk the gardener with the arrow keys, then press Enter to open it - or just click the marker. Drag to look around.
hintTouch: Walk the gardener with the stick, then tap a marker to open it. Swipe to look around.

quant-affiliate.title: Quant Technology - Affiliate System
quant-affiliate.description: A two-sided referral module inside a multi-tenant prop-trading dashboard: traders apply to become partners, then get referral and coupon codes, commissions and payout requests. Tenant admins approve or suspend partners, set tiers, commission rates and grace periods, run campaigns, read analytics and assemble the application form in a drag-and-drop builder. Everything routes through one typed service layer with Zod-validated API boundaries, consumed by loaders and around fifty resource-route actions.

monevis.title: Monevis
monevis.description: The marketing site for a prop-trading firm: pricing and challenge plans, live payouts, a leaderboard, certificate lookup and a blog - localised into sixteen languages and shipped from a Turborepo with a shared UI package.

monevis-platform.title: Monevis Platform
monevis-platform.description: The trader dashboard behind Monevis: trading accounts and terminals, payout requests, identity verification, rankings, certificates and billing - a GraphQL client app with generated types, Storybook components and Playwright coverage.

happy-tails.title: HappyTails
happy-tails.description: The public face of a dog shelter: visitors browse dogs looking for a home, send adoption requests, donate and get in touch - while staff keep the adoption pipeline moving.

doggy-board.title: DoggyBoard
doggy-board.description: An admin dashboard for running a dog shelter - dogs, adoptions, donations and media in one place. Charts summarise where the shelter stands, and every record is editable through validated forms.

green-bay.title: greenBay
green-bay.description: An eBay-style marketplace with accounts, category and price filtering, a cart, checkout and listings you can put up for sale yourself - backed by a Node and MySQL API.

speech: Hey! My name si Simona Zozuľaková and i am {{age}}. I've been programming since high school.
I'm a frontend developer with 3+ years of commercial experience, building production web applications in React, Next.js and TypeScript.
I'm comfortable across the rest of the stack too - typed API layers, GraphQL and Node services.
I've been working on large multi-tenant dashboards, design systems and heavily localised products.
I'm used to talking to clients directly, translating their feature requests and bug reports into shipped work.
Planning tasks, keeping the development workflow moving and taking ownership of what I build matter to me as much as the code itself.
Right now I'm open to frontend roles, where I can contribute, grow as a developer and keep building meaningful things.
